description: This PHP source file defines the Download model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class provides methods for retrieving download information related to customer orders, counting total downloads, and adding download reports. It interacts with the database and configuration settings to manage downloadable product data.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Model class handling download-related database interactions, including retrieving download info, listings, total counts, and creating download reports.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves download details for a specific download ID, ensuring it belongs to the current customer and matches order status filters.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Returns a list of downloads for the current customer, with pagination support, filtered by order status and language.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Counts total number of downloads associated with the current customer and filters.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the download report table, logging download access with IP and country info.
